sql:
SELECT s.School, f.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School_Code
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, f.FundingType
HAVING AVG(f.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, f.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School_Code
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, f.FundingType
HAVING AVG(f.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
) sub ON s.CDSCode = sub.cds
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside' AND sub.avg_math_score > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.dname = 'Riverside Unified' AND sa.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT DISTINCT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.County = 'Riverside';

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = SUBSTR(st.cds, 4)
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside' AND st.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds AND s.School = sa.sname
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType

WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType

FROM schools s

SELECT s.School, f.[Charter Funding Type]
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School_Code
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, f.[Charter Funding Type]
HAVING AVG(f.[AvgScrMath]) > 400;
